PROJECT BRIEF

Making room for
what’s next.

Website redesign · Q3 2026

Owner   Design & Brand team

Last updated   July 14, 2026

Status   In progress

Overview

Our website is the front door to everything we do. As our product and community have grown, it’s time for that first impression to catch up.

This project brings a clearer story, a more thoughtful experience, and a refreshed visual identity to our website. The goal is simple: help people understand who we are, find what they need, and feel confident taking the next step.

What we’re working toward

  • Clarity over complexity. Make our product story easy to understand.
  • A connected experience. Create a consistent design language across every page.
  • Built for everyone. Make accessibility and performance part of the foundation.
  • Room to grow. Build a flexible system that evolves with us.

Scope & deliverables

We’ll focus on the pages that matter most to our visitors, starting with the homepage, product pages, and the paths that connect them.

DeliverableOwnerTarget
Discovery & content auditStrategyWeek 1–2
Visual direction & design systemDesignWeek 3–4
Core page designsDesignWeek 5–6
Development & launchEngineeringWeek 7–10

A few guiding principles

“Make it useful. Make it clear. Make it feel like us.”

Every decision should bring us closer to an experience that feels considered, human, and unmistakably ours.

Next steps

  1. Align on the brief and gather feedback.
  2. Schedule discovery sessions with the team.
  3. Kick off the content audit and explore visual directions.

A fresh start, built together.
